name: ModelVariant660Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant660us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two copies of a glowing sprite and a ring of spinning shards, then eight orbs thrown in turn from two model joints, each circled by five sparks and spawning a spinning double band ring and a sphere of Gouraud rays where it lands); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs three texture images and seeds the glows, shards, orbs, rings, rays, sparks and delay from the command row indexed by the request; every call then counts down the delay or runs one frame, returning 4 while a ray sphere is active, 1 on the first frame after frame 64 that finds every element inactive, 2 on later such frames and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-677 and 744 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
